children: Chewy, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $3.33B and diluted EPS of $0.2, compared with $3.1B and $0.14 in the prior-year quarter, as net income rose to $80.5M from $62M.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by active customer growth and higher spend per customer, with net sales up about 7.3% for the quarter and roughly 7.5% year-to-date.
Consumables and pet health categories led the gains; hardgoods and other categories posted double-digit growth.
Autoship subscription sales remained dominant at roughly 84–85% of net sales, supporting recurring revenue and retention.
Active customers increased about 3.8% to 21.7 million, with modest contribution from the SmartPak acquisition.
Investments continued in fulfillment capacity, the pharmacy network and veterinary clinics to support demand; capital projects are ongoing.
